column2: Only at the gym
Open More → Training & rest and save your gym while you're there.
From then on the games can only be played at the gym – that keeps the focus on training.
Your location is only compared on your phone.
Level and XP

You earn XP for completed exercises, complete workouts, personal bests, runs and games. With it you climb the athlete levels – from “Warm-up set” to “Legend”. Tap your level card to see what earns how much XP.
Only the first round after a ticked-off set counts for the leaderboard. You can play further rounds freely.
Reaction Rush is free to play; Premium unlocks all seven games.
Running
Running goal, running plan and logging runs
Set up a running plan
Open Training and choose Running at the top.
Under Goal & plan you set your running goal, e.g. 10 km on a specific date or simply running regularly.
Choose a suitable plan and your running days.
Logging runs
Under Week you see your planned sessions.
After the run, enter distance and duration – and if you like, heart rate, effort and a note. The app calculates the pace.
Went for a spontaneous run? Use + Log a free run.
How do I run the session?
Every session has a 📖 Guide. It tells you how fast to run and what to pay attention to. You'll also find all guides under Guides.
History
Under History you see your pace, your distances and your kilometres per week.
New to running? Read the guide “How fast should I run?” first.
Progress
Weight, analysis and weekly review
Weight
Open Progress → Weight and tap Log weight.
It's best to weigh yourself in the morning, after the toilet and before breakfast.
The curve shows your 7-day trend. It's more meaningful than individual days.
Analysis

Under Analysis the app evaluates the last few weeks: does your weight trend match your goal? Are you eating enough protein? Are you training regularly? If needed, you adjust your calorie goal right there.
Weeks
Under Weeks you compare what you planned with what you actually ate.
In the free version the charts show the last 4 weeks; Premium shows your whole history.
You'll find the history for each exercise under Training → Strength → Exercises.
Leaderboard
Compare yourself with others – optional
Join in
Open Training → Strength → Today and tap the leaderboard card.
Choose a nickname and an avatar and agree. You don't need an email.
If you like, enter your sex, age group and weight. That way you're compared fairly with people who match you. Others don't see these details.
The scores

Strength & running: your strength relative to your body weight and your best running time. Games: your monthly rating from the break games. Overall: everything together plus consistency, with tiers from Rookie to Legend – plus the monthly league with promotion and relegation. Friends: your groups and your gym.
Friends group
Open the leaderboard and switch to Friends.
Create a group and give it a name.
Share the code or link with your friends. Anyone who enters or taps it is in.
My gym
Go to your gym and open Leaderboard → Friends.
Tap Set gym and allow location access.
Choose your gym from the list or create it with a new name. Now you can see who's the strongest at your gym.
Stopping
Under More → Data & backup you can end your participation at any time. All your data on the server is then deleted immediately.
Unrealistic values aren't counted. If you spot a cheater, report them with the report button.
Backup, account & export
Don't lose data, switch phones
Backup as a file (free)
Open More → Data & backup.
Tap Create / share backup and save the file, e.g. in your cloud or by emailing it to yourself.
On a new phone, tap Import data and choose the file.
Account with cloud backup
Open More → Account & cloud and enter your email address.
Confirm the email and set a password.
From then on the app backs up your data automatically. On a new phone you simply sign in.
Export data (Premium)
Open More → Data & backup and scroll to Export data.
Choose the period and what to include: weight, nutrition, training, running.
Tap PDF report (e.g. for your coach or doctor) or CSV (Excel) for your own analysis.
Without an account and without a backup, your data is gone if you delete the app or lose your phone. So back up regularly.
Settings & reminders
Goals, rest, reminders, photo analysis
Change goals
Under More → Goals & nutrition you change your goal or set calories, protein, carbohydrates and fat by hand.
Reminders
Open More → Reminders.
Switch on what the app should remind you about: training, water or meals.
Set the times and allow notifications when your phone asks.
Set up photo analysis
Get a free key from Google AI Studio (Gemini).
Enter it under More → Photo analysis.
Now you can take a photo when adding food and the AI estimates the nutritional values.
Training & rest
Under More → Training & rest you set how long the rest between sets is, see your break games with records and manage your saved gyms.
The photo estimate is a guideline. For exact values, weigh your food or scan the barcode.
Premium
What's free, and what do you get with Premium?
Free

Logging food, barcode, recipes, weekly plan and shopping list, training and running plans, logging sets and runs, leaderboard, backup – the essentials are always free. A few extras are limited: 2 automatic meal and training plans per month, charts of the last 4 weeks, one break game, 3D guides for 8 basic exercises and your own friends groups of up to 3 people.
With Premium
All limits are gone: unlimited plans, your whole history, all break games, all 3D guides, large friends groups, more designs for personal-best images and export as PDF and Excel.
Manage subscription
Under More → Premium you see your subscription, can restore a purchase (e.g. on a new phone) and get to subscription management in the Play Store or App Store. You can cancel there at any time.
FAQ
When something doesn't work
The barcode isn't found
Not every product is in the database. Then enter the nutritional values with Enter yourself – next time you'll find it under “Recently eaten”.
The camera doesn't start
Allow the app to access the camera in your phone's settings (Apps → GainPilot → Permissions).
I don't get any reminders
Check whether notifications are allowed for GainPilot and whether battery saver is restricting the app.
Is there an update?
The app notices new versions by itself and shows a notice. Under More → About the app you see your version.
Something isn't working properly
Open More → About the app.
Tap Save diagnostic log.
Send us the file together with a short description. It only contains technical details, no food or training data.
I have a new phone
With an account you simply sign in. Without an account, create a backup on the old phone and import it on the new one (see “Backup, account & export”).
